Junte-se a nós e trabalhe de uma maneira melhor.

title: Gerente de infraestrutura em tecnologia da informação
description:
We Are PepsiCo

Join PepsiCo and Dare for Better! We are the perfect place for curious people, thinkers and change agents. From leadership to front lines, we're excited about the future and working together to make the world a better place.

Being part of PepsiCo means being part of one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with our iconic brands consumed more than a billion times a day in more than 200 countries.

In Brazil since 1953, PepsiCo has well-known brands such as QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI®, among others.

A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where all people are welcome. Here, you can dare to be you. No matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love, you can always influence the people around you and make a positive impact in the world.

Know more: PepsiCoJobs

Join PepsiCo, dare for better.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Infrastructure and Operations Senior Manager for Brazil to lead and evolve our global IT infrastructure and operations landscape. This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our technology environment for Brazil. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise, strong leadership capabilities, and a passion for operational excellence in a fast-paced, multinational setting.

Your Impact

Strategic Leadership

• Define and execute the global infrastructure and operations strategy aligned with business goals.

• Lead transformation initiatives, including cloud migration, automation, and modernization of legacy systems.

• Collaborate with senior stakeholders across IT, security, and Brazil business units to ensure alignment and value delivery.

Infrastructure Management

• Oversee data centers, cloud platforms, network architecture, and enterprise systems for Brazil.

• Ensure high availability, performance, and scalability of Brazil's infrastructure services.

• Manage vendor relationships and service level agreements (SLAs).

Operational Excellence

• Lead IT operations, including incident management, change management, and problem resolution.

• Implement and monitor KPIs to drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.

• Ensure compliance with global standards, policies, and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

• Build and mentor a high-performing infrastructure and operations team in Brazil.

• Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and collaboration.

• Manage budgets, resource planning, and talent development.

Who Are We Looking For?

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

• 10+ years of experience in IT infrastructure and operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.

• Proven experience in managing global infrastructure in a multinational environment.

Technical Skills

Infrastructure & Cloud

• Deep expertise in cloud platforms: Azure and AWS (architecture, migration, cost optimization).

• Strong understanding of hybrid cloud and multi-cloud environments.

• Experience with virtualization technologies.

Networking

• Advanced knowledge of LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, firewalls, load balancers, and network segmentation.

• Familiarity with Cisco, and other enterprise-grade networking solutions.

Systems & Platforms

• Proficiency in Windows Server and Linux environments.

• Experience with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and identity management.

• Define and execute the strategy for end-user devices and services.

• Strong understanding of ITIL and Agile

Leadership & Communication

• Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Strategic thinker with a hands-on approach to problem-solving.

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic, matrixed, and culturally diverse organization.

• Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

What can you expect from us:

  • Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.
  • Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning.
  • Development programs according to Leadership skills.
  • Specialized training according to the role.
  • Learning experiences with internal and external providers.
  • We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.
  • Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life.
  • A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.
  • And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!

Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.

Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.

Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.

The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.

What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.

Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality : At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving : We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Assistente fiscal
description:

title: SDR / CLOSER
description:

  • Habilidades para contornar e lidar com objeções;

title: Gerente de Desenvolvimento de Negócios
description:
Na Amaris Consulting , acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 6.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

Nosso objetivo é construir um futuro mais inteligente e sustentável, impulsionando a inovação e o crescimento de nossos clientes e de nossos talentos.

Descrição do cargo

Sua missão será criar, desenvolver e tornar rentável e sustentável a sua própria Unidade de Negócio , tendo controle operacional e estratégico sobre ela.

Para garantir o crescimento dessa estrutura, você atuará diariamente em cinco eixos principais:

Suas missões

Negócios e Estratégia

  • Gerir, coordenar e desenvolver sua própria Unidade de Negócio, assegurando seu crescimento.
  • Realizar um mapeamento de clientes/ofertas, tecnologias e competências do mercado com o apoio de outros departamentos internos do Grupo.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais técnicas e financeiras estruturadas e negociar preços.
  • Preparar e conduzir reuniões de qualificação entre clientes e consultores.
  • Realizar revisões de projeto, acompanhamento e relatórios de desempenho.

Relacionamento com o Cliente

  • Monitorar as atividades dos clientes para antecipar e conquistar novos projetos.
  • Manter o portfólio de clientes atualizado e fortalecer parcerias existentes.
  • Abrir novas contas, gerenciando aspectos legais e contratuais.

Gestão Financeira

  • Analisar e otimizar o Profit & Loss (P&L), calculando margens.
  • Realizar análises avançadas de rentabilidade, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e elaborar planos de ação para otimizar faturamento e margem contributiva.
  • Gerenciar temas relacionados à recuperação de créditos.

Gestão de Equipe

  • Contribuir na elaboração e análise de planos de negócios.
  • Acompanhar e apoiar o desenvolvimento das pessoas-chave da equipe.
  • Propor e implementar novos processos e iniciativas de melhoria.

Recursos Humanos

  • Participar do recrutamento e da gestão da equipe de consultores (prospecção, entrevistas, relatórios, assinatura de contratos etc.).
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de carreira da equipe (atribuição de funções, avaliações, envolvimento de talentos-chave etc.).
  • Antecipar e gerenciar situações de intercontrato, propondo soluções adequadas.

Seu perfil

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, com histórico de cumprimento ou superação de metas.
  • Forte entendimento das técnicas de vendas e do ambiente corporativo B2B.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação.
  • Fluência em português e inglês.
  • Formação superior completa
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro , com oportunidades de realocação entre projetos .
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 45% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil .
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua .
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping , com foco em carreira e evolução profissional .

title: Supervisor de Logística
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Logística para atuar no time de Operações Logísticas.

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Supervisionar operações de armazenagem, transporte, distribuição e expedição, assegurando prazos, qualidade e normas.
  • Acompanhar fretes, transportadoras e prestadores de serviços, equilibrando custos, eficiência e cumprimento de contratos.
  • Coordenar equipe de carregamento e gestão de estoque, prevenindo rupturas e excessos.
  • Monitorar programação de entregas e coletas, solucionando problemas operacionais e acompanhando indicadores (KPIs).
  • Controlar custos logísticos, identificar oportunidades de redução e buscar soluções que aumentem eficiência e reduzam desperdícios.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades logísticas estejam conformes com normas e regulamentos internos, incluindo segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente.

Quais os requisitos?

Superior Completo;

Experiência em supervisão de equipe e processos logísticos;

Residir na região de Bebedouro - Barretos/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

title: "#982228 Senior Data Engineer"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta posição irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolvimento de Infraestrutura de Dados: Colaborar com o Data Architect para projetar e construir pipelines e soluções de armazenamento escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Integração de Dados: Conectar múltiplas fontes de dados, incluindo fluxos em tempo real, garantindo uma coleta de dados abrangente e precisa.
  • Garantia da Qualidade de Dados: Implementar processos de validação e limpeza de dados, mantendo altos padrões de qualidade.
  • Administração de Banco de Dados: Gerenciar e otimizar ambientes Snowflake, incluindo tunning de performance de queries, otimização de armazenamento e garantia de integridade e segurança dos dados.
  • Processos ETL/ELT: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis com Azure Data Factory (ADF), garantindo movimentação e transformação de dados eficiente e confiável.
  • Segurança de Dados: Assegurar a segurança dos dados e a conformidade com regulamentações e padrões relevantes.
  • Integração via APIs: Atuar com integração de dados via REST APIs e manipulação de payloads em JSON.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Aplicar práticas sólidas de modelagem relacional, incluindo normalização, chaves estrangeiras, constraints e tipos de dados.
  • Expertise em Snowflake: Utilizar recursos avançados do Snowflake, como virtual warehouses, micro-particionamento e papéis de segurança (security roles).
  • Azure Data Factory: Desenvolver pipelines no ADF, com foco em resolução de erros e monitoramento de performance.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com domínio em arquitetura de dados e princípios de gestão de dados.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas ( pós-graduação é um diferencial ).
  • SQL

  • Frameworks de processamento de dados como Apache Spark e Hadoop
  • Experiência prática com integrações entre sistemas e controle de versão utilizando GitHub.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas, com habilidade para lidar com grandes volumes e complexidade de dados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração, com perfil proativo e foco em trabalho em equipe.
  • Compromisso com qualidade e precisão dos dados, com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a ambientes dinâmicos e de ritmo acelerado, respondendo rapidamente a mudanças de escopo ou prioridades.

title: Advogado(a) Sênior Tributarista (Consultoria)
description:
Direto ao ponto:  Vaga para advogados com experiência de pelo menos 7 anos em direito tributário; Trabalho híbrido em SP (escritório colado à estação de metrô/trem/terminal de ônibus Pinheiros), com regime de home office duas vezes por semana (segundas e sextas); Remuneração mensal de mercado + plano de saúde + anuidade OAB + bônus semestrais + plano de associados detalhado com visibilidade de metas e progressão na carreira; Foco em consultoria e planejamento tributário, atendendo essencialmente clientes PJ, mas também com alguma exposição a clientes PF e internacionais. Equipe pequena e produtiva, em ambiente profissional, organizado e amigável. Para além dos detalhes adiante, os interessados podem obter muita informação sobre nosso estilo e perfil pelo nosso site, página do Linkedin e canal do YouTube. Somos uma boutique tributária famosa pelo pragmatismo e didática, estando entre as mais reconhecidas do Brasil pelos principais rankings do setor (Chambers and Partners, Legal500, Leaders League, Latin Lawyer, Lacca, Análise e ITR, único ranking global focado em tax). INTERESSADOS DEVEM SUBMETER CANDIDATURA EXCLUSIVAMENTE VIA PROCEDIMENTO EM NOSSO ANÚNCIO DE VAGA NO LINKEDIN.

Em detalhes:

Resumo da vaga:  Buscamos profissional legitimamente interessado e capaz em liderar a equipe em temas tributários complexos, de quaisquer setores e tributos. Todo trabalho a ser performado é previamente alinhado com o cliente e o sócio da área, ocasião em que são fixados em conjunto expectativas de resultado final e prazo. A pessoa terá à sua disposição outra profissional na área de consultoria e com ela deve providenciar a entrega final ao cliente, sempre sujeita à aprovação do sócio; Embora haja revisão pelo sócio, espera-se autonomia na condução dos trabalhos, de modo que a pessoa precisa ter EXPERIÊNCIA NA ÁREA E INDEPENDÊNCIA para poder encaminhar a demanda e revisar o trabalho de outro profissional mais júnior. A vaga serve para quem tem capacidade e vontade de desenvolver o escopo programado com muita independência. Em especial, vale dizer que se trata de uma vaga para profissionais que tenham profundo interesse e experiência em tributário. É essencial ter disposição para aprender e é um imenso diferencial ter passagem por auditoria ou formação em contabilidade. Não temos nem teremos profissionais com baixa iniciativa ou preguiça de estudar. Além do aprendizado na performance das atividades, nossa rotina contempla atualização constante (leitura de clippings diários e participação ativa em reuniões técnicas quinzenais).

Responsabilidades:  Coordenar os trabalhos da outra profissional, auxiliando e realizando pesquisas e preparação de minutas de respostas a consultas de clientes, predominantemente em formato de e-mail ou apresentação de slides, mas eventualmente memorandos, pareceres e simulações em Excel. Além de trabalhos tributários diversos, todos os nossos associados estão também envolvidos em projetos internos do escritório, como produção de pautas para reuniões técnicas, artigos para newsletter, organização de eventos, submissions de rankings, entre outros.

Qualificações mínimas para a vaga:  Necessária inscrição na OAB/SP, inglês e mínimo de 7 anos de prática consultiva na área tributária. Conhecimentos práticos de contabilidade são essenciais. Embora formações acadêmicas possam ajudar, o que mais diferencia nossos advogados é a vontade por aprender e fazer bem feito. Existe política de home office (2x por semana) eo escritório está convenientemente localizado ao lado do terminal Pinheiros (metrô, trem e ônibus) e da marginal Pinheiros.

Resumo da equipe de consultoria tributária:  Nosso time é pequeno e jovem, mas extremamente competente. Somos profissionais e preocupados com a utilidade de nossas entregas aos clientes. Competimos com escritórios que nos superam em tempo de experiência e em tamanho de equipe, mas somos igualmente ranqueados por publicações especializados e temos ótimos feedbacks de nossos clientes. Lidamos majoritariamente com empresas, dos mais variados setores, tratando de quaisquer temas (tributos diretos e indiretos). Temos outra equipe de contencioso tributário, mas esta vaga é para a de consultoria e planejamento. Estruturamos nossa equipe para que o crescimento de cada profissional seja possível e dependente apenas de sua performance individual, não de uma competição com outros profissionais no mesmo estágio de carreira.

O que oferecemos:  Prezamos por um ambiente profissional, leve e saudável. A remuneração inicial desta vaga vai depender de qual faixa o candidato for enquadrado em nosso plano detalhado de 8 níveis de associado. A remuneração mensal é composta de pro labore + dividendos. Todos os nossos associados recebem também plano de saúde, anuidade da OAB e distribuições semestrais de resultados, de acordo com critérios claros de nosso plano de sócios. Basicamente, as distribuições semestrais variam de acordo com (i) avaliações subjetivas dos sócios quanto a competência técnicas, pessoais e interpessoais,; (ii) resultado coletivo do escritório e (iii) metas individuais previamente estabelecidas. Temos um plano de sócios e associados muito detalhado e organizado, com definição de níveis e critérios para progressão do profissional entre estes. Além de licenças maternidade e paternidade remuneradas e sem prejuízo a bônus, prevemos a possibilidade de fixação de trabalho remoto por até 5 semanas por ano, entre outras regras infelizmente ainda não tradicionais no mercado jurídico. Nosso escritório, embora com apenas 6 anos de prática, já está listado entre os mais reconhecidos tanto em consultoria como contencioso tributário e private wealth, ao lado das maiores e mais tradicionais firmas brasileiras, muitas full service e de renome nacional e internacional, em todos os principais rankings do setor (Chambers and Partners, Legal500, Leaders League, Latin Lawyer, Lacca, Análise e ITR, único ranking global focado em tax).

Muito mais sobre nosso escritório em

Responderemos a todos os candidatos, priorizando aqueles que se atentaram para os requisitos deste anúncio e possuem compatibilidade mínima com a vaga. Eventuais CVs recebidos por e-mail serão avaliados apenas depois daqueles que seguiram o processo via Linkedin.

description:

Highlights :

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page !

Job Description

Senior Manager position to act as the primary Compliance Officer for Samsung’s Latin America business, serving as a trusted advisor and compliance leader. This position will implement and oversee the compliance program at both regional and subsidiaries levels, ensuring adherence to all applicable laws and regulations of Latin America, including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Panama and Peru. This role requires the Compliance Officer to collaborate extensively with the broader Legal and Compliance team to uphold Samsung’s global standards and will advise stakeholders on the compliance implications of business decisions.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Serve as the designated Compliance professional in accordance with local regulations.
  • Oversee and administer the compliance program for Samsung Latin America.
  • Develop, maintain, and enforce compliance policies and procedures, ensuring ongoing adherence of all applicable regulations, such as labor, fair competition, anti-bribery, anti-corruptions, etc.
  • Conduct due diligences and maintain strong relationship with key stakeholders.
  • Ensure day-to-day compliance with periodic activities, such as internal audits, communication campaigns and trainings.
  • Identify, assess and mitigate legal and compliance risks specific to the Latin America business through effective controls and monitoring.
  • Lead and oversee ethics investigations into ethics and integrity incidents, utilizing investigative techniques and data analysis to detect irregularities.
  • Stay informed on regulatory developments in the Latin America region and assess impacts on compliance and business operations. Produce timely and accurate reports to Senior management and Global Office, maintaining compliance with all obligations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law required.
  • Prior experience at a multinational company and/or Law firms.
  • Specialization or Master’s Degree in Compliance, Corporate Governance or related corporate areas is desirable.
  • Compliance certification (CCEP, CPC-A) will be considered as a plus.
  • Advanced English Skills.
  • Advanced Spanish Skills.
  • Experience and knowledge of handling compliance programs at corporate environment with desirable knowledge of the Latin America region.
  • Sound judgment in selecting the best approach to resolve complex issues.
  • Strong team orientation with excellent skills to foster collaboration across diverse teams.
  • Ability to engage with all levels of management to achieve objectives.
  • Outstanding organizational skills, delivering accurate work and meeting tight deadlines consistently.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priories and adapting quickly to changing business needs.

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact

Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities for career advancement
  • Global networking and collaboration

title: Técnico de manutenção
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Técnico de Manutenção, você irá:

  • Ser responsável pela manutenção corretiva e preventiva, assim como solucionar os problemas diários de Guindastes;
  • Reportar e dar feedback a Sany periodicamente sobre todas as falhas e trabalhos realizados;
  • Concluir as orientações técnica e outros trabalhos emitidos pelo departamento comercial ou conforme necessidade da Sany;
  • Manter um bom relacionamento com clientes, representantes e colaboradores;
  • Elaborar relatório de Diagnóstico de falhas.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Ter concluído o ensino técnico em Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou áreas afins;
  • Ter experiência com manutenção em Guindastes.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).
  • Document ingestion at scale (PDF/HTML/images), schema’d extraction, validation.
  • Secure, auditable data design ( HIPAA/PII ), APIs/webhooks, event-driven workflows.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/ HubSpot / Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.
  • MLOps fundamentals: data/model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, rollback.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • Resume parsing APIs (Sovren, Textkernel, Affinda) or document intelligence services.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Zendesk automation; Jasper AI content ops; CMS automation (HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager
description:
About the Team

You’ll be joining a small but mighty People team of four, spread across the U.S. and Brazil. We’re a tight-knit crew that covers Talent Acquisition, People Operations, and other key functions that keep our company running smoothly as we scale.

We move fast, take big swings, and care deeply about building a thoughtful employee experience. Everyone on the team has broad ownership, and we’re the kind of group that figures things out together, learns quickly, and keeps it real along the way. If you’re energized by a high-impact role where no two days look the same, you’ll fit right in.

What is the role?

We are seeking an experienced and strategic HR Business Partner to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, driving HR initiatives that support our company's growth, culture, and organizational effectiveness. You will play a critical role in aligning HR strategies with business objectives and ensuring our teams are empowered and engaged.

This role will be hybrid to our São Paulo office, which will require you in office 2-3 days per week.

This is a CLT contract, paid in $BRL.

In this role you'll:

  • Partner with senior leadership and management to develop and implement HR strategies that align with business goals.

  • Coach and develop leaders to build strong leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Provide expert guidance on organizational design, talent management, employee relations, and performance management.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and work in a matrix environment collaborating with global teams to drive HR initiatives.
  • Drive initiatives related to employee engagement, culture, and talent development.
  • Support leaders through change management, workforce planning, and capability development.
  • Analyze HR metrics and data to identify trends and recommend solutions.
  • Leverage AI tools and technologies to enhance HR processes and decision-making.
  • Ensure compliance with employment laws and internal policies.
  • Act as a point of contact for employee concerns and facilitate effective communication across teams.

What you'll bring:

  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken).
  • Strong interpersonal and influencing skills with the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels in a remote and hybrid environment.
  • Proven experience in organizational design, including org structure development, job architecture, and operating model design.
  • Strong track record in coaching and developing leaders at various levels.

Additional details:

At Teachable, we are committed to providing fair and competitive pay (using market data to inform our pay bands), rewarding high performance, and ensuring all employees have the opportunity and ability to impact Teachable’s overall company value. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically following performance review cycles currently conducted annually or in conjunction with a promotion.

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: GIS Python Developer
description:
GIS Python Developer (QA/QC Automation – ArcGIS Workflow Manager)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Full-Time / Contract

About the Role

We are looking for a GIS Python Developer to design, develop, and implement automated Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) processes for spatial data. The role involves writing Python scripts (primarily using ArcPy or the ArcGIS API for Python ) and integrating them into Esri’s ArcGIS Workflow Manager to streamline and automate GIS data validation across teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop QA/QC Scripts:
  • Create and maintain Python scripts to automatically identify and correct spatial data issues such as:
  • Missing or invalid geometry
  • Polygon overlaps or gaps
  • Attribute inconsistencies
  • Coordinate system mismatches
  • Topology and connectivity errors (e.g., roads not connecting properly)
  • Integrate with ArcGIS Workflow Manager:
  • Configure and embed QA/QC scripts as automated steps within ArcGIS Workflow Manager task sequences, enabling:
  • Automatic validation after data edits or updates
  • Flagging and reporting of errors for correction
  • Consistent enforcement of spatial data quality standards
  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance:
  • Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.
  • Collaborate Across Teams:
  • Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.
  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .
  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .
  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .
  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .
  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.
  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.
  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.

What You’ll Achieve

You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

title: Global Demand Planner
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Global Demand Planner to join our team in a permanent position at our São Paulo office (South Zone) .

Position Objective

The Global Demand Planner is responsible for leading the demand planning process across regions and business units to ensure accurate forecasts, optimize inventory, and align supply with market demand. This role collaborates cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to deliver a reliable demand signal that supports business objectives and customer satisfaction.

Your challenges will include:

  1. Develop, maintain, and communicate the global demand forecast at multiple levels of aggregation (product, category, region, customer).
  2. Lead monthly demand planning cycles, including forecast reviews, consensus meetings, and alignment with key stakeholders.
  3. Analyze historical sales data, market trends, promotional activities, and business intelligence to refine forecasts.
  4. Drive continuous improvement in forecast accuracy and bias reduction through advanced planning tools, statistical models, and process enhancements.
  5. Provide insights to senior management on demand trends, risks, and opportunities, enabling data-driven decision-making.
  6. Ensure alignment of the demand plan with financial targets and strategic objectives.
  7. Act as key user for ERP and demand planning systems, supporting enhancements, testing, and best practice adoption.
  8. Prepare and present reports, KPIs, and dashboards to track forecast performance and process effectiveness.

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Economics, or related field (Master’s degree is a plus).
  • Experience: Solid experience in the role, preferably in multinational environments.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced Excel and proficiency in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
  • Languages: Advanced English (French is a plus).
  • Availability to travel.

What we offer:

  • Family Health Plan (national coverage, employee contribution)
  • Family Dental Plan (national coverage)
  • Food Allowance Card: R$450.00
  • Meal Card
  • Eye Care Assistance (reimbursement up to R$544.00 per year)
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation Assistance (6% salary deduction)

  • Childcare Assistance (R$478.45 for 24 months after maternity leave return)
  • School Supplies Kit (R$158.00 for children up to 21 years old enrolled in elementary to high school/technical education)
  • Christmas Card: R$370.00
  • Christmas Toy (for employees’ children aged 0 to 12 years)

Working Hours: Administrative Shift

Work Location: SWM Office – South Zone, São Paulo

title: Session Border Controller SR (100% remoto)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com Session Border Controller;
  • Experiência com Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, etc ;
  • Experiência com Protocolos: SIP, RTP, TCP, UDP ;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).

Responsabilidades:

Como Session Border Controller Sênior, o profissional será responsável por projetar, configurar, implantar e manter soluções avançadas de SBC, garantindo comunicação de voz/vídeo segura, interoperável e com alta disponibilidade. Atuará com equipamentos como Cisco, Mitel, Avaya (ou equivalentes), sendo capaz de configurar e otimizar regras de sinalização (SIP) e fluxos de mídia (RTP), ajustar parâmetros de transporte TCP/UDP, implementar e gerenciar políticas de segurança para proteger contra ameaças como DoS/DDoS, fraude em chamadas e intercepções. Será responsável por assegurar a interoperabilidade entre diferentes protocolos e codecs, bem como a integração de SBC com outros componentes de rede e telecomunicações, como redes internas, operadoras externas, NATs, firewalls e VPNs. Deverá monitorar e otimizar a qualidade de serviço (QoS), latência, jitter, perda de pacotes, bem como realizar troubleshooting de incidentes, fazer auditorias de tráfego/comunicação, propor melhorias e atualizações, e garantir que os sistemas estejam alinhados com normas e compliance aplicáveis. Trabalhará colaborativamente com equipes de voz, redes, segurança e operações, influenciando decisões de arquitetura, definindo padrões de configuração, documentando processos e participando da sustentação contínua das operações

O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo CLT - PLR, VR, Previdência, Gympass, Convênio médico e Odonto e etc.

Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Senior Cloud Data Engineer
description:
RESUMES IN ENGLISH PLEASE

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, secure, and resilient data pipelines and systems on cloud platforms.
  • Architects and implements advanced data integration solutions to support complex analytics, business intelligence, and enterprise reporting needs.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, business analysts, product owners, and application engineers—to understand and deliver on evolving data requirements.
  • Ensures the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and security through comprehensive testing, validation, and robust governance practices.
  • Monitors, optimizes, and scales data workflows to achieve performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency targets across both cloud and legacy environments.
  • Proactively identifies, investigates, and resolves data-related issues, providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.
  • Champions continuous improvement by staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, best practices, and by driving innovation in data engineering processes and solutions.
  • Partners with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to define and enforce data standards and compliance requirements.
  • Leads design reviews and technical workshops to uplevel engineering practices across the organization.
  • Contributes to strategic planning for data platform evolution and modernization initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE: Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or other related field of study; or any combination of relevant work experience and education

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with a strong emphasis on designing and implementing cloud-based solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, with hands-on experience in both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
  • Extensive experience architecting and operating data platforms on AWS and Azure; relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer Associate) strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and enterprise data governance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and mentoring data engineering teams, driving technical excellence and fostering collaborative environments.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and proactively in fast-paced settings.
  • Outstanding communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration abilities, with a proven track record of partnering with business and technical stakeholders.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Cloud Platform (AWS): Extensive hands-on experience architecting and operating data solutions on AWS; relevant AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, AWS Solutions Architect) strongly preferred.
  • Data Warehousing: Deep expertise in data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and enterprise data governance, with a focus on AWS-native and integrated solutions.
  • Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, orchestration, and data processing tasks within AWS environments.
  • Data Integration: Proven ability to design and implement advanced data integration solutions supporting complex analytics and business intelligence requirements on AWS.
  • Database Management: Strong experience with both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB) databases, including AWS-native database services.
  • Data Quality & Security: Demonstrated commitment to maintaining high data quality, integrity, and security in AWS cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Tools & Technologies: Expertise with Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, Control-M, and familiarity with modern data engineering frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Fivetran, Matillion) as deployed on AWS.
  • Infrastructure: Solid understanding of both traditional on-premises (virtual/physical) and AWS cloud-based infrastructure, including Windows and Linux environments.
  • Open Source & AWS Services: Working knowledge of a variety of open-source tools and AWS services for data engineering, automation, and orchestration.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Proven track record of leading design efforts, mentoring engineers, and fostering technical excellence within teams.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaboration: Outstanding communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration abilities, partnering effectively with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Continuous Improvement: Commitment to staying current with AWS advancements, industry trends, and driving innovation in data engineering practices.

Bitget is one of the world’s leading digital assets ecosystems. With over 120 million registered users, Bitget has one of the most comprehensive suites of blockchain products and services available via bitget.com.

Our mission is to support the growth of the digital assets industry and we believe it represents the future of finance. What we do empowers the future of finance by ensuring secure, efficient and smart digital transactions.

We are one of the fastest growing companies in the digital asset sector. If you are looking for cutting-edge work, where you will have opportunities to develop your career among peers who are experts in their field, and you believe in the future of crypto currency, then look no further than Bitget!

What you'll do

  • Translate corporate documents into Brazilian Portuguese with accuracy and cultural relevance.
  • Proofread and edit content to ensure consistency, grammar, and style.
  • Apply internal glossaries and style guides for terminology consistency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on context and objectives.
  • Manage multiple translation projects under tight deadlines.
  • Use CAT tools effectively to support translation workflow.
  • Safeguard sensitive and confidential information.
  • Participate in linguistic quality assurance reviews.
  • Stay current with industry language trends, especially in crypto.

What you'll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Translation, Linguistics, or related field (or currently pursuing).
  • Proven translation experience, ideally in corporate or crypto-related settings.
  • Fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Solid understanding of grammar, syntax, and cultural nuances.
  • Proficiency in CAT tools.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and attention to detail.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • High professionalism in handling confidential content.

Why Bitget?

  • Bitget is the world's leading web 3 platform for copy trading and one of the world's largest and most respected exchanges
  • We are a global company with staff members from over 50 different countries and regions
  • We are growing and looking for world-class ambitious talents to help us continue this journey
  • We have a streamlined structure that empowers employees to work efficiently, delivering the best results in a short timeframe
  • We offer competitive salaries and benefits
  • Blockchain technology and digital assets have the potential to change finance in a way no other technology can - be part of it!

If you are ambitious and believe that digital assets could be the next financial and technological revolution, please apply!

title: Senior MLOps / LLM Engineer
description:
Description

We’re seeking an experienced DevOps/LLMOps or MLOps/ LLMOps Engineer to design, deploy, and maintain the infrastructure supporting Large Language Model (LLM) platforms. This role blends DevOps best practices with AI/ML expertise, with a focus on building and scaling agentic AI systems that integrate directly with LLMs. You’ll drive development of intelligent, autonomous agents while ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance across training, fine-tuning, and deployment pipelines.

English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:

  • A1 Beginner
  • A2 Elementary
  • B1 Intermediate
  • B2 Upper-Intermediate
  • C1 Advanced
  • C2 Proficient

Responsibilities

  • Own strategy and execution of agentic AI systems using LLMs and autonomous decision-making components
  • Build prototypes and scale them into MVPs demonstrating real-world AI viability
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to embed LLM agents into user-facing features
  • Design and manage CI/CD pipelines for LLM training and deployment workflows
  • Provide technical leadership on DevOps, security, and deployment strategies for AI/ML models

Requirements

  • 5+ years building and deploying ML or GenAI systems in production, with strong architectural and systems-level ownership
  • 2+ years of proven experience with LLM integration, LLM-based agents, or autonomous reasoning systems
  • End-to-end AI/ML delivery: data prep, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring
  • Cloud expertise (AWS, GCP, or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines, multi-tenant deployments, and infrastructure automation
  • Experience with Databricks and familiarity with Langchain / GenAI toolkits
  • Strong agility and ability to deliver in fast-moving product environments

Nice To Have

  • Advanced degree (MS/Ph.D.) in ML, Computer Science, or related field
  • Deep expertise in DevOps/MLOps practices and scaling secure, enterprise-grade AI workflows
  • Broader data engineering knowledge, especially in Databricks
  • Background in aviation industry

title: Montador Óptico
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global em produtos de cuidados visuais de classe mundial, incluindo óculos icônicos, tecnologia de lentes avançada e soluções digitais de ponta. Nosso trabalho vai além do nosso negócio. Estamos abrindo novas fronteiras, promovendo a inclusão e a colaboração, abraçando a agilidade, acendendo a paixão e causando um impacto positivo no mundo.

Somos o grupo das marcas de cuidados visuais e óculos mais amadas e reconhecidas do mundo. Nosso portfólio incomparável de marcas exclusivas de óculos, como Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear e Costa, é complementado por mais de 20 marcas licenciadas de prestígio. Nossas tecnologias avançadas de lentes incluem a marca Essilor, com Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest e Transitions. Nossa rede de venda direta ao consumidor conta com aproximadamente 18.000 lojas, que oferecem aos consumidores cuidados visuais de alta qualidade e experiências de compra de classe mundial, com uma abordagem verdadeiramente omnicanal , através de nossas bandeiras de varejo mundialmente renomadas, como Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò e a rede GrandVision. O negócio é complementado por plataformas líderes de comércio eletrônico, como Ray-Ban.com, EyeBuyDirect, Clearly e muito mais.

Tenha a oportunidade de crescer conosco e projetar sua carreira profissional. Conheça a EssilorLuxottica e faça parte da nossa comunidade internacional. Você consegue enxergar o seu # FutureInSight ?

Se interessou? Veja a descrição das atividades e inscreva-se:

O Montador óptico será responsável por realizar a montagem e desmontagem de produtos, inspeção de lentes oftálmicas e corte, garantindo a qualidade dos produtos (lentes e armações), organizar e administrar o fluxo de produção.

Como escopo do trabalho o MONTADOR ÓPTICO deverá realizar:

  • Executar o procedimento operacional padrão para as atividades a serem realizadas.
  • Realizar a montagem e desmontagem dos produtos (lentes em armações).
  • Garantir os procedimentos e atendimentos as normas de segurança estabelecidas pela empresa.
  • Garantir o fluxo produtivo e qualidade dos produtos.
  • Garantir o bom uso e cuidados com os equipamentos no fluxo de produção (máquinas).
  • Em caso de problemas no fluxo produtivo e/ou equipamentos (máquinas), acionar o primeiro nível de help chain (facilitador).

Requisitos :

Ensino Médio Completo;

Experiência em montagem de óculos (lentes e armações) e medição de lentes em óticas ou laboratórios;

Disponibilidade de horário.

Benefícios:

Assistência médica

Assistência odontológica

Desconto em produtos

Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados

Previdência privada

Refeitório

Seguro de vida

Vale alimentação

Vale-transporte ou fretado (conforme disponibilidade)

title: Scrum Master
description:
Empresa multinacional do setor de tecnologia, referência em soluções de colaboração e computação em nuvem na América Latina, está em busca de uma pessoa que tenha atuado como Scrum Master, com experiência na coordenação e entrega de projetos tradicionais e híbridos, atuando de forma estratégica e colaborativa com times técnicos e stakeholders em nível LATAM.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Mid/Senior)
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!

VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.

We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)

We’re looking for a versatile Full-Stack Engineer to join our team. While we’re primarily seeking professionals comfortable working across the stack, from building Vue.js + TypeScript interfaces to developing Kotlin/Spring Boot APIs with PostgreSQL, we also welcome candidates with strong Frontend or Backend experience who are eager to collaborate in a full-stack environment.

What you will do :

  • Design and implement full-stack features and applications.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs using Kotlin/Spring Boot.
  • Build intuitive, responsive UIs with Vue.js and TypeScript.
  • Work with PostgreSQL to design efficient schemas and queries.
  • Ensure high-quality code through testing (Playwright) and code reviews.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
  • Participate in system design and architecture discussions.

What we expect from you :

Mid-Level Engineers

  • Experience with Kotlin/Spring Boot for backend development.
  • Proficiency with Vue.js and TypeScript for frontend development.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs and databases.
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows.
  • Good English communication skills.

Senior Engineers

  • Deep expertise across backend and frontend, able to design end-to-end systems.
  • Strong architectural knowledge focused on scalability and performance.
  • Experience mentoring peers and leading technical discussions.
  • Ability to balance priorities across the stack.
  • Good English communication skills.

Differential requirements:

  • Experience with Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools like Prometheus or Grafana.

If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Sales Analyst
description:
At Blueground , our vision is to make people feel at home wherever they choose to live. For us, that means ensuring our guests have the peace of mind, flexibility & confidence they need to explore life’s latest adventure.

We’ve grown a lot since our founding in 2013, having raised more than $258m+ in funding, to date -- and that’s just the beginning. We’re now hosting guests in more than 15,000 homes in 32 cities around the world (and growing!), with an aim to hit 100,000 homes in 100 cities by 2025.

Our vision comes to life through our ways of working. For our 1,000+ member team located across 17 countries, we’ve created a culture of collaboration, inclusiveness, and opportunity.

We believe our people should have the power to choose their preferred way to work. Depending on the role’s requirements, team members can choose to work full time in one of our offices, work fully remote, or choose a hybrid model between the two.

We are driven by our core values. To our team, Time is our most important resource. Excellence isn’t simply a standard, but an exciting way to look at life. We Care deeply about our guests and colleagues. Our relationships are built around Transparency , which builds trust and improves communication.

We are looking to recruit a Sales Analyst based in São Paulo to join our B2C Inbound Sales department. As member of our sales team you will manage inbound sales requests concerning bookings of Tabas properties .

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ATTRIBUTIONS

  • Respond to incoming property sales inquiries full cycle and handling requests (via phone, email, whatsapp, etc) generated from all online sales channels (Website, Airbnb, Vivareal, Zap, Corporate Housing Partners, Corporates) offering clients the best accommodation solution based on their need;
  • Support the entire sales process to ensure delivery against key performance metrics;
  • Interact and negotiate with clients, help them to understand the business, and solve any queries they might have;
  • Proactive daily pipeline management in our CRM.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Nice to have experience in sales or account management ;
  • Ability to run proper exploratory/discovery calls, be an active listener and objection handling and negotiation;
  • Flexibility to work on weekends and holidays;
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment;
  • Customer-first mindset and hunter mentality;
  • A coachable individual able to implement feedback;
  • Advanced in English, ability to talk and write with normality.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Meal/Food voucher on the Flex Flash card of R$40.00 per day (no payroll discount);
  • Transportation voucher based on your route to the office (with 3% discount on payroll);
  • Our Health Care is Amil (with co-participation);
  • Our Dental Plan is Amil (without co-participation);
  • Daycare allowance for employees with children up to 5 years old;
  • For your Physical Health, we have TotalPass, our gym benefit;
  • For your Emotional Health, we have the Moodar platform;
  • Partnership with Cambly for an English course;
  • Flexible Holidays (from 6 months onwards you are entitled to proportional holidays);
  • 25% discount when using Tabas apartments;
  • Once a month we have a celebration the Tabers Birthday's;
  • Birthday Day Off + giftcard paid on the Flash card, to make your day even special;
  • Our workplace has a cinema room, spaces for decompression and an equipped kitchen;
  • In the condominium we have a Bike rack, Full Kitchen and Lunch Room.
